sets.title: Authorization decision: boolean vs exception-throwing expression
sets.description: The same resource-authorization decision in three semantically equivalent forms: carrier A uses the pristine guard-clause boolean-return form, carrier B uses an exception-throwing style with try/catch translation to boolean (sem_error_style variant), and carrier C uses a dependency-injection-style inline approach (sem_di_style variant). All three compute behaviorally identical results. No two carriers share a token run long enough for token/line tools to pair them, so only semantic detection is expected to recover the cluster.
sets.notes: SEM-04 variant (sem_error_style) uses exceptions to express denial. SEM-05 variant (sem_di_style) uses inline DI-style checks. Behavioral equivalence enforced by gen/seeds/access_guard/equivalence_test.php.

distractors.reason: near-miss: same auth vocabulary (user/resource/roles/grants/status) but computes a numeric trust score, not a boolean decision
